# Latchway public documentation

> Latchway is a self-hosted gateway for feature-bound, DPoP-authorized access from untrusted client applications to server-selected AI or HTTP upstreams. Version 1 remains a source candidate until its release evidence is published.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://docs.latchway.dev/index.md): Understand the product boundary and choose a task-oriented path.
- [Local quickstart](https://docs.latchway.dev/operate/quickstart.md): Start the source candidate with PostgreSQL and pass local verification.
- [Choose an SDK](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/choose-an-sdk.md): Select iOS, Android, Web, or React Native without conflating their trust models.
- [Architecture at a glance](https://docs.latchway.dev/start/architecture-at-a-glance.md): See the control plane, data plane, PostgreSQL, and upstream boundaries.
- [Release status](https://docs.latchway.dev/release-status.md): Separate tested source behavior from pending publication and production evidence.

## Native client journeys

- [iOS quickstart](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/ios/quickstart.md): Send and correlate a feature-bound request from a signed iOS host.
- [iOS App Attest](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/ios/app-attest.md): Configure App Attest and understand what its evidence does and does not establish.
- [iOS production checklist](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/ios/production-checklist.md): Review release signing, policy, observability, and device-proof gates.
- [Android quickstart](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/android/quickstart.md): Build the source client and prepare an OkHttp request for platform trust.
- [Android Play Integrity](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/android/play-integrity.md): Distinguish local, Play internal-testing, and production verdicts.
- [Android production checklist](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/android/production-checklist.md): Review package, certificate, track, policy, and device-proof gates.
- [React Native quickstart](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/react-native/quickstart.md): Use one TypeScript surface backed by native iOS and Android security modules.
- [React Native iOS setup](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/react-native/ios-native-setup.md): Configure bundle identity, App Attest, CocoaPods, and Keychain groups.
- [React Native Android setup](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/react-native/android-native-setup.md): Configure the Gradle composite, package identity, certificate, and Play project.
- [React Native production checklist](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/react-native/production-checklist.md): Track the two native release proofs independently.

## Web client journey

- [Web quickstart](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/web/quickstart.md): Use vanilla TypeScript, WebCrypto, existing identity, and a feature-bound fetch.
- [Browser trust](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/web/browser-trust.md): Understand identity, WebCrypto possession, origin policy, App Check, and Turnstile.
- [Browser versus Node.js](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/web/browser-vs-node.md): Keep browser and server runtime trust claims separate.
- [Origins and CORS](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/web/origins-and-cors.md): Configure exact browser origins and preflight behavior.
- [Content Security Policy](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/web/content-security-policy.md): Add the gateway origin to a bounded browser CSP.
- [Web production checklist](https://docs.latchway.dev/clients/web/production-checklist.md): Review identity, origin, risk-signal, XSS, and storage controls.

## Security and Installation Families

- [Security boundary](https://docs.latchway.dev/concepts/security-boundary.md): Review the complete protected-request lifecycle and remaining threats.
- [Identity and attestation](https://docs.latchway.dev/concepts/identity-and-attestation.md): Distinguish authentication, attestation, authorization, and DPoP.
- [Installation Families](https://docs.latchway.dev/concepts/installation-families.md): Group related components while preserving independent keys and sessions.
- [Client Components](https://docs.latchway.dev/concepts/client-components.md): Understand root, delegated, identity-only, and browser-risk trust.
- [Trust provenance](https://docs.latchway.dev/concepts/trust-provenance.md): Follow trust sources, expiry, and revocation through a component graph.
- [Delegated component security](https://docs.latchway.dev/security/delegated-components.md): Understand why delegated trust is not independent App Attest.
- [Physical-device proof](https://docs.latchway.dev/mobile/device-proof.md): Bind an exact signed artifact and source coordinate to device evidence.

## Operate and investigate

- [Admin console](https://docs.latchway.dev/administration/console.md): Use capability-scoped, same-origin control-plane workflows.
- [Configuration](https://docs.latchway.dev/administration/configuration.md): Create, validate, plan, simulate, activate, and roll back immutable revisions.
- [Operational observability](https://docs.latchway.dev/administration/observability.md): Inspect request, usage, cost, latency, trust, and audit metadata.
- [Production readiness](https://docs.latchway.dev/operations/production-readiness.md): Review the complete deployment and release checklist.
- [Deployment](https://docs.latchway.dev/operations/deployment.md): Deploy API, worker, and migration roles with PostgreSQL as the required external service.
- [Backup and restore](https://docs.latchway.dev/operations/backup-restore.md): Capture, restore, and verify recoverable PostgreSQL state.
- [Upgrades](https://docs.latchway.dev/operations/upgrades.md): Upgrade with compatibility checks and a documented rollback boundary.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.latchway.dev/troubleshooting.md): Start from stable error codes and redaction-safe request identifiers.

## Contracts and agent resources

- [Client API](https://docs.latchway.dev/reference/client-api.md): Inspect the generated DPoP-bound client wire operations without a misleading playground.
- [Admin API](https://docs.latchway.dev/reference/admin-api.md): Inspect the generated control-plane operations and safe local request policy.
- [Error registry](https://docs.latchway.dev/reference/errors.md): Map stable gateway and SDK-local errors to bounded remediation.
- [Compatibility matrix](https://docs.latchway.dev/reference/compatibility.md): Read support claims generated from the canonical compatibility registry.
- [Configuration schema](https://docs.latchway.dev/reference/config-schema.md): Inspect the generated immutable configuration contract.
- [CLI reference](https://docs.latchway.dev/reference/cli.md): Use credential-safe administrative commands and verification workflows.
- [Agent resources](https://docs.latchway.dev/community/agent-resources.md): Use Latchway instructions and skills without inventing fields or security claims.
- [Latchway skill](https://docs.latchway.dev/skill.md): Integrate, operate, and troubleshoot Latchway with explicit trust boundaries.

## Usage boundaries

Never recommend an upstream provider credential in a client application. Distinguish authentication, attestation, authorization, and DPoP. Prefer feature IDs over physical model names. State exact Latchway and framework versions. Treat Web and React Native as distinct security models: browser WebCrypto and risk signals are not native hardware-backed attestation.
